strings.Esta ferramenta não oferece retomada inc: This tool does not support incremental resume.
strings.A ferramenta compara origem e destino a: The tool compares source and destination on every run.
strings.Adiciona -U: não copia mensagens duplica: Adds -U: does not copy duplicate messages.
strings.Adiciona -U: não copia mensagens que já: Adds -U: does not copy messages that already exist at the destination.
strings.Adiciona -U: não despeja mensagens que j: Adds -U: does not dump messages that already exist in the directory.
strings.Adiciona -U: não recopia mensagens que j: Adds -U: does not recopy messages that already exist at the destination.
strings.Adiciona -n: não copia mensagens que já: Adds -n: does not copy messages that already exist in the Mbox.
Adds -n: does not copy messages that already exist in the Mbox file.
strings.Copia mensagens e pastas de uma conta IM: Copies messages and folders from one IMAP account to another, with duplicate control, date filters and update mode.
strings.O progresso é exibido a cada mensagem co: Progress is shown for every copied message. Use Resume (-U) to skip messages that already exist at the destination.
strings.Lista separada por vírgulas. Em branco c: Comma-separated list. Leave blank to copy all folders.
strings.Incluir subpastas das caixas informadas: Include subfolders of the listed mailboxes (-R)
strings.Correspondência exata dos nomes informad: Exact match for the listed names.
strings.Remover mensagens da origem depois de co: Remove messages from source after copying (-C)
strings.Não copiar mensagens marcadas para exclu: Do not copy messages marked for deletion (-P)
strings.Sincroniza duas contas IMAP: adiciona me: Synchronizes two IMAP accounts: adds missing messages at the destination, removes those missing from the source and matches flags.
strings.A sincronização é naturalmente idempoten: Synchronization is naturally idempotent: running again continues where it left off. Use test mode to simulate without changing anything.
Leave blank to synchronize all folders.
strings.Não excluir mensagens do destino (-n): Do not delete messages from destination (-n)
strings.Migra contas inteiras entre servidores,: Migrates entire accounts between servers, with folder-name mapping and destination structure control.
strings.As credenciais de origem e destino do fo: The source and destination credentials in this form are used to generate the user list required by the script. A standard run migrates a single user.
strings.Remover do destino o que não existe na o: Remove from destination what is missing at the source (-X)
strings.Conecta em um servidor POP3 antigo, baix: Connects to an old POP3 server, downloads the messages and uploads them to a modern IMAP account.
strings.Informe as credenciais POP3 na origem e: Enter the POP3 credentials for the source and the IMAP credentials for the destination. The script keeps its own log in pop3toimap.log.
strings.Remover mensagens do POP3 após migrar (-: Remove messages from POP3 after migrating (-r)
strings.Sincroniza um arquivo local Mbox com uma: Synchronizes a local Mbox file with an IMAP folder, adding and removing messages to reflect the file.
strings.A sincronização é feita comparando Messa: Synchronization compares Message-IDs, so it can be run again to keep the server aligned with the local file.
strings.Exporta cada pasta IMAP como um arquivo: Exports each IMAP folder as an Mbox file in Thunderbird's native format, ready to open or import in the application.
strings.Para abrir direto no Thunderbird, feche: To open directly in Thunderbird, close Thunderbird and use the profile's Mail/Local Folders folder as the destination; folders will appear with the configured prefix. Alternatively, import the Mbox files using the ImportExportTools NG extension.
strings.Para abrir no Thunderbird, selecione Mai: To open in Thunderbird, select the profile's Mail/Local Folders. Close Thunderbird first.
strings.Evita conflito com pastas existentes. As: Avoids conflicts with existing folders. Thunderbird folders will use this prefix.
Leave blank to export all folders.
strings.Opcional. Formato DD-MMM-YYYY; inclui me: Optional. DD-MMM-YYYY format; includes messages from this date.
Optional. DD-MMM-YYYY format; includes messages up to this date.
strings.Baixa os e-mails do servidor IMAP e salv: Downloads messages from the IMAP server and saves one Mbox file per folder on the local computer.
strings.O modo Resume adiciona -n e evita copiar: Resume adds -n and avoids copying messages that already exist in the destination Mbox file.
strings.Os arquivos Mbox serão criados neste dir: Mbox files will be created in this directory.
strings.Ajuda a evitar sobrescrita e identifica: Helps avoid overwrites and identifies files in Thunderbird.
strings.Atenção: neste script a lista de pastas: Note: in this script the folder list uses -M.
strings.Lê arquivos Mbox locais e envia as mensa: Reads local Mbox files and uploads the messages to an IMAP account.
strings.Informe um diretório de mailfiles (-m) o: Enter a mailfiles directory (-m) or a single file (-f). For a single file, also enter the IMAP folder name (-n).
strings.O script não compara duplicatas. Use -R: The script does not compare duplicates. Use -R to remove messages from the file after uploading.
strings.Remover mensagens do arquivo após enviar: Remove messages from file after uploading (-R)
strings.Faz backup dos e-mails do servidor IMAP: Backs up IMAP messages in Maildir format, with one individual file per message.
strings.O usuário do Maildir é preenchido com o: The Maildir username falls back to the source username when left blank.
strings.Opcional. Inclui mensagens a partir dest: Optional. Includes messages from this date.
strings.Opcional. Inclui mensagens até esta data: Optional. Includes messages up to this date.
strings.Lê uma estrutura Maildir local e envia o: Reads a local Maildir structure and uploads messages to an IMAP account.
strings.As credenciais do destino e o caminho do: The destination credentials and Maildir path are used to generate the user file required by the script.
strings.Lê a estrutura de arquivos de um perfil: Reads a Mozilla Thunderbird profile and uploads the messages to an IMAP server.
strings.Informe a pasta raiz do perfil local. O: Enter the local profile root folder. Resume adds -U to avoid duplicates at the destination.
strings.Despeja a estrutura bruta do IMAP e as m: Dumps the raw IMAP structure and messages to disk for backup or later restoration.
strings.Use em conjunto com o Importar dump IMAP: Use together with Import IMAP dump (dumptoIMAP.pl). Resume adds -U to skip messages already present in the directory.
strings.Usar a data do cabeçalho no arquivo (-Y): Use header date for file date (-Y)
strings.Não perguntar sobre o cálculo de tamanho: Do not prompt about size calculation (-q)
strings.Recomendado para execução pela interface: Recommended for execution from the interface.
strings.Restaura para o servidor IMAP uma estrut: Restores to the IMAP server a message structure previously created by imapdump.pl.
strings.Informe o mesmo diretório de dump usado: Enter the same dump directory used for the export.
strings.Localiza mensagens duplicadas em uma con: Finds duplicate messages in an IMAP account and can move or purge them.
strings.Sem a opção de purga o script apenas inf: Without the purge option the script only reports what it would do. Purging is permanent: review the options before running.
Leave blank to examine all folders.
strings.Usar hash MD5 do corpo da mensagem (-H): Use MD5 hash of message body (-H)
strings.Exclui em massa pastas de uma conta IMAP: Bulk deletes folders from an IMAP account based on a regular expression.
Test mode is enabled by default. Uncheck it to actually delete matching folders.
strings.Exemplo: ^Teste exclui todas as pastas q: Example: ^Test deletes all folders starting with Test.
strings.Modo de teste: apenas mostrar o que seri: Test mode: only show what would be deleted (-t)
strings.Marca todas as mensagens de uma pasta IM: Marks all messages in an IMAP folder as deleted and runs expunge.
strings.Esta operação remove definitivamente as: This operation permanently removes messages from the specified folder.
strings.Obrigatório. Todas as mensagens desta pa: Required. All messages in this folder will be removed.
strings.Gerencia, limpa ou esvazia a lixeira da: Manages, cleans or empties the account trash automatically.
strings.A opção de esvaziar a lixeira é destruti: Emptying the trash is destructive. Without it, the script only processes the configured trash folder.
strings.Aplica regras de filtro nas mensagens do: Applies filter rules to server messages, moving or deleting based on sender, subject and other criteria.
strings.O arquivo de regras é criado fora do apl: The rules file is created outside the app. Test mode is enabled by default to prevent accidental changes.
strings.Modo de teste: não mover mensagens (-t): Test mode: do not move messages (-t)
strings.Calcula o tamanho total da conta e de ca: Calculates total account and folder sizes, generating a report in the data directory.
strings.O relatório completo também é gravado em: The full report is also written to list_account_sizes.report in the data folder.
strings.Não usar a extensão QUOTA do servidor (-: Do not use server QUOTA extension (-N)
strings.Lista as pastas de uma conta IMAP com a: Lists IMAP folders with message counts and sizes.
strings.A saída detalhada é exibida no painel de: Detailed output is shown in the log panel. Use it to choose folders for other tools.
strings.Compara origem e destino, verificando qu: Compares source and destination, checking message counts, folder integrity and differences between accounts.
strings.Use o modo de contagem para uma verifica: Use count mode for a quick check or disable it to compare message by message.
strings.Realiza buscas complexas diretamente no: Runs complex searches directly on the IMAP server without downloading messages.
strings.Informe os critérios no formato campo=va: Enter criteria as field=value, separated by semicolons or new lines.
strings.Exemplos de campos: from, to, subject, b: Example fields: from, to, subject, body, since, before, larger, smaller.
strings.Valida host, usuário e senha e mede o te: Validates host, username and password and measures basic IMAP operation times.
strings.Use antes de iniciar uma cópia ou sincro: Use before starting a copy or synchronization to confirm credentials.
strings.Lista os recursos técnicos suportados pe: Lists server capabilities such as IDLE, QUOTA, SSL and IMAP extensions.
strings.Use a saída para diagnosticar compatibil: Use the output to diagnose compatibility before choosing a migration tool.
strings.Testa autenticação moderna XOAUTH2 no Gm: Tests modern XOAUTH2 authentication with Gmail, the same flow used by providers such as Office 365 when they do not accept a regular password.
strings.O script testa imap.gmail.com:993. Infor: The script tests imap.gmail.com:993. Enter the username and OAuth2 token; the server is fixed and does not need to be filled in.
strings.As senhas ficam no banco local e não são: Passwords are stored in the local database and are not written to logs.
strings.O resumo da execução aparecerá aqui assi: The execution summary will appear here when the tool starts.
strings.Motor de processamento de e-mails alimen: Email processing engine powered by rick-sanders-imap-tools
strings.Informe o diretório de mailfiles ou um a: Enter a mailfiles directory or an individual file.

aboutHtml:
Application purpose

Turbo IMAP is a graphical interface for simplifying the migration, backup, export, import, cleanup and auditing of email accounts that use the IMAP protocol.

IMAP (Internet Message Access Protocol) keeps messages on the server and synchronizes folders, messages, attachments and read states across multiple devices. When migrating between providers — for example, from Gmail to Microsoft 365 — the folder structure must be copied and the mailbox contents preserved, avoiding message loss and rework.

The application brings the Perl scripts into forms, validates parameters, builds the commands, runs each tool in a subprocess, tracks progress, writes logs and keeps the latest settings. This reduces manual errors and makes long operations safer and traceable without requiring the user to memorize dozens of command-line options.

Technologies used

  • Electron + Node.js — desktop application and process execution.
  • Bulma CSS — responsive interface and visual components.
  • SQLite — settings, protected credentials and local history.
  • Strawberry Perl portable — runtime included to run the scripts on Windows.
  • child_process + secure IPC — script execution and interface communication.

Project repository

Source code, versions and issue tracking: github.com/emileite/turbo-imap

Script origin

The IMAP operations are executed by the open source suite rick-sanders-imap-tools, created by Rick Sanders and available at github.com/rick-sanders/imap-tools. The Perl scripts are kept separate from the application interface.

Acknowledgements

Special thanks to Rick Sanders and everyone who contributed to the rick-sanders-imap-tools suite, whose work made this application possible. Thanks also to the Electron, Bulma, SQLite and Strawberry Perl communities.

Important notice

Credentials are stored locally. Cleanup and deletion tools can permanently remove messages. When available, keep test mode enabled and make a backup before destructive operations.
thunderbirdHtml:
Thunderbird

How to load messages into Thunderbird

Native Mbox format

Option 1 — open directly in Local Folders (recommended)

  1. Close Thunderbird completely.
  2. In Turbo IMAP, use the profile's Mail\Local Folders folder as the destination.
  3. Keep a prefix such as TurboIMAP- to avoid overwriting existing folders.
  4. Run the backup and open Thunderbird.
  5. The folders will appear under Local Folders as TurboIMAP-INBOX, TurboIMAP-Sent, etc.

Option 2 — export and import later

  1. Choose a regular backup folder as the destination.
  2. Run the backup to generate the Mbox files.
  3. In Thunderbird, install the ImportExportTools NG extension.
  4. Right-click Local Folders.
  5. Choose ImportExportTools NG > Import mbox file and select the files.

Close Thunderbird before writing directly to Mail\Local Folders. The end date is inclusive. A complete guide is also saved in the destination folder as README-THUNDERBIRD.txt.
thunderbirdGuide:
Turbo IMAP - Thunderbird backup
================================

Mbox files generated with prefix: {prefix}
Date range: {range}

OPTION 1 - Open directly in Thunderbird (Local Folders)
-------------------------------------------------------
1. Close Thunderbird completely.
2. In Turbo IMAP, use the following folder as destination:
   ...\Thunderbird\Profiles\<your-profile>\Mail\Local Folders
3. Run the backup.
4. Open Thunderbird. The folders will appear under "Local Folders"
   with the prefix {prefix} (for example, {prefix}INBOX).
   If they do not appear, close and reopen Thunderbird.

OPTION 2 - Export now and import later
--------------------------------------
1. Export to a regular backup folder.
2. In Thunderbird, install the ImportExportTools NG extension.
3. Right-click "Local Folders" and choose
   ImportExportTools NG > Import mbox file.
4. Select each generated Mbox file.

IMPORTANT
---------
- Close Thunderbird before writing directly to Mail/Local Folders.
- The prefix prevents overwriting existing folders such as Inbox and Sent.
- Mbox files have no extension when used as local folders.
- For a new partial backup, keep Resume enabled (-n).
